ORDINANCE PROHIBITING THE USE OF TRACKED VEHICLES AND EQUIPMENT UPON THE ROADWAYS OF TREUTLEN COUNTY, GEORGIA

WHEREAS, the Treutlen County Commissioners are charged with the creation, maintenance, and repair of the roadways of Treutlen County; and,

WHEREAS, the operation of tracked vehicles and equipment upon said roadways has on many occasions left permanent damage to said roadways, causing safety concerns and necessitating repair expenses which have to date been born by the County;

NOW THEREFORE, it is resolved and ordained that the following is adopted as an Ordinance of Treutlen County, Georgia.

1.

No person, company, or corporate entity shall operate any tracked vehicle or equipment upon the paved roadways of Treutlen County without specific prior written permission of the Treutlen County Board of Commissioners. While operation upon dirt roadways is not strictly prohibited, any such operation which results in significant damage to the dirt roadway necessitating repair by the County shall constitute a violation of this Ordinance.

2.

The penalty for violating this Ordinance shall be a fine of up to $1,000.00, up to 30 days in the county jail, and restitution of the costs of repair. This Ordinance shall be enforced in accordance with the State law.

3.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances that conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed. The sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, and phrases of this ordinance are severable. Should any section, paragraph, sentence, clause, or phrase of this ordinance be rendered invalid by a court of law, the remaining sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, or phrases shall not be affected, but shall continue in effect until amended or repealed by action of the governing authority of Treutlen County, Georgia.

4.

This ordinance shall go in effect on April 1, 2026.
